_comment: API-style Python capacity backed by a lambda-like callable.

objective.name: api.combine
objective.description: Combines two fields through a callable symbol

#root.role: Combine two string inputs through a callable symbol in the wrapper runtime.

transformation_contract.morphing: Two input strings become one combined string returned through a callable symbol in the wrapper runtime.
invariants: api.combine must remain bounded by its declared inputs, outputs, and effects.
Internal implementation strategy may vary, but the declared contract surface must remain stable.
success: api.combine returns payload and matter effects consistent with the declared outputs when it succeeds.
Successful execution preserves the semantic change described by morphing.
failure: api.combine fails when required inputs or matter contracts are not satisfied.
The capacity fails when the underlying runtime or wrapper cannot satisfy the declared contract.
notes: This contract constrains expected behavior and observable effects, not the internal implementation decomposition.
Humans and LLMs should interpret the capacity through the declared interface and semantic guarantees first.
